The wake generated by the hull is inconsistent with the vessel's apparent speed and mass. The water around the hull lacks realistic displacement foam and churning, appearing somewhat pasted onto the water surface.
The railings and small deck structures show slight geometric warping and lack crisp edges, blending slightly into the superstructure, indicative of AI generation smoothing.
